title: OL-20261123-1: Q-SEED-CRED: a deployed seed has no repository or source-control credential, so its repository loops cannot run
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** detector seed-autonomous fails (failure-audit pass)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation seedadmit --autonomy
**Status:** closed

Root cause of fm-seed-not-autonomous. deploy/deploy-seed.mjs uploads a generated seed with a D1 binding and a cron only. Needed: one repository per seed, and a GitHub App installation token minted for that repository only and handed to the seed Worker by the platform (never the App key, never a token that reaches ultrastable/ultrastable). Closes when the seed reads ignition stage looping.

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-23T10:01:21Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** shelved (executor-failed, 2026-11-23T11:21:44Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: github-models-llama: RuntimeError: non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
